record.paper_title: Infinity in string cosmology: A review through open problems
record.original_question: What precise relation, if any, does the ambient cosmological construction have to twistor theory, especially to the null projective twistor 5-space PN and related H-space constructions, and how should one understand the validity of the asymptotic condition and the meaning of non-locality in the ambient 5-space?

evidence.quote:
6.9 Relation to twistors
It is possible (although not clear at present) that our construction bears some relation to twistor space, in particular, the space PN - the null projective twistor 5-space.
In our case, we have a ﬂuid in the 5-space, not a Λ, and the validity of the asymptotic condition is not so clear. Also the meaning of non-locality on our ambient space is not yet clear.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the ambient cosmological construction in which a four-dimensional spacetime $(M^4,g)$ is realized as a hypersurface in a five-dimensional ambient manifold $(\widetilde M^5,\widetilde g)$ carrying a perfect-fluid stress-energy content (rather than a pure cosmological constant $\Lambda$), together with an asymptotic flatness/conformal condition imposed at infinity of the ambient space. Recall also the twistor-theoretic setting: for a four-dimensional Lorentzian spacetime, projective twistor space $\mathbb{PT}\cong\mathbb{CP}^3$ contains the null projective twistor 5-space $\mathbb{PN}\subset\mathbb{PT}$ (the real hypersurface of projective twistors satisfying the null condition $Z^\alpha\bar Z_\alpha=0$), and the associated nonlinear graviton / $\mathcal{H}$-space constructions produce complex four-manifolds with self-dual conformal structures from deformations of (regions of) twistor space.

Formulate and answer the following:

(a) Construct an explicit correspondence (or prove the non-existence of such a correspondence) between the ambient 5-manifold $\widetilde M^5$ of the perfect-fluid ambient cosmological construction and the null projective twistor 5-space $\mathbb{PN}$ of the embedded spacetime $M^4$, identifying how the fluid data on $\widetilde M^5$ translate into structures on $\mathbb{PN}$ and into associated $\mathcal{H}$-space constructions.

(b) Determine under what precise geometric and analytic conditions on the ambient fluid the asymptotic condition imposed in the ambient construction is well-defined and consistent (analogous to, but distinct from, the asymptotic conditions natural in the $\Lambda$-vacuum case).

(c) Give a precise mathematical formulation of "non-locality" on the ambient 5-space $\widetilde M^5$, and characterize its meaning in terms of the (conjectured) twistor correspondence in (a).
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as a speculative open direction relating an ambient 5-dimensional cosmological construction to twistor theory and $\mathcal{H}$-space; no published resolution establishing such a correspondence, the validity of the asymptotic condition for a fluid ambient space, or a precise notion of non-locality on the ambient 5-space could be located. It appears to remain an open conceptual/technical problem.

status_evidence.snippet: Review article framed around open problems in string/ambient cosmology, including a section on relation to twistors flagged as not clear at present.
status_evidence.claim: The relation to twistor space PN and the meaning of the asymptotic condition and non-locality in the ambient 5-space are listed as unresolved.
